description: Positive interim analysis — DSMB recommends trial continue, early efficacy signal

raw_document.title: LambdaMed Announces Positive Interim Analysis from RADIANCE Phase 3 Trial of LMX-301
raw_document.raw_text:
LambdaMed Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ: LMPH) today announced results from a pre-specified interim analysis of the Phase 3 RADIANCE trial (NCT05345678) evaluating LMX-301 (lambdavumab) in patients with moderate-to-severe systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE).

The interim analysis was conducted by an independent Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) at the pre-specified 50% information fraction. Based on the interim data, the DSMB has recommended that the trial continue with no modifications to the protocol.

Interim Results (data cut-off: May 15, 2024):
- 324 patients randomized (of 648 planned)
- Preliminary efficacy signal: SRI-4 response rate at Week 24: 48% (LMX-301) vs. 31% (placebo)
- Hazard ratio for SRI-4 response: 0.64 (95% CI: 0.49-0.84)
- p-value at interim: 0.001 (above the pre-specified efficacy boundary for early stopping)
- No new safety signals identified

The DSMB determined that the predefined futility boundary was not crossed and the benefit-risk profile remains favorable.

'We are encouraged by these interim results, which suggest LMX-301 is tracking well against the primary endpoint,' said Chief Medical Officer Dr. Amanda Torres. 'We expect to complete enrollment by Q4 2024 and report final data in H2 2025.'
